summary: Ship with high confidence and no blocking findings. The narrow CoWaiter::WaitWithCallback path now returns WaitStatus::TimedOut when the second deadline sample yields remain_ms <= 0, matching the existing CombinedWait guard and preventing a non-firing 0ms timer from becoming an untimed wait. Review covered the pre-merge patch on b0ba3e0; after merging origin/main the identical guard was re-applied and post-merge focused unit tests passed. Public interface, notification protocol and scheduler threading are unchanged. The historical CI failure's unique root cause is not proven by natural stress samples.
